description: This file defines the Returns model class for the Opencart admin report module, providing methods to retrieve return data and total return counts with filtering options.

classes.name: Returns
classes.description: Model class for handling return reports, including fetching return data and counts with filters.

methods.name: getReturns
methods.description: Retrieves a list of return records based on provided filters, with support for grouping and pagination.

methods.name: getTotalReturns
methods.description: Calculates the total number of return records based on provided filters.
